rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
rules.quote: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.requirement: Landlords may increase rent for RSO-covered units by a maximum of 3% annually during the period from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
rules.title: RSO Annual Rent Increase Limit

rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
rules.quote: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.requirement: Landlords may no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities in rent increases.
rules.title: Prohibition on Utility Surcharge Increases
